shloka_text: कथां कथयतां तेषां जयं चाकाङ्क्षतां शुभम् । व्यतीता रजनी शीघ्रं शत्रुघ्नस्य महात्मनः ।। 7.68.1 ।।
transliteration: kathāṃ kathayatāṃ teṣāṃ jayaṃ cākāṅkṣatāṃ śubham | vyatītā rajanī śīghraṃ śatrughnasya mahātmanaḥ || 7.68.1 ||
translation: कथां the talk, कथयतां while speaking, तेषां of them, जयं victory, च and, आकाङ्क्षतां while desiring, शुभम् auspicious, व्यतीता passed, रजनी the night, शीघ्रं quickly, शत्रुघ्नस्य of Shatrughna, महात्मनः the great-souled one.
explanation: While they were conversing and wishing for an auspicious victory, the night quickly passed for the great-souled Shatrughna.
comments: At morning Lavana comes out for food, and Shatrughna, having crossed the Yamuna, stands armed at the gate -- the demon mocks and threatens to devour him, but Shatrughna, weeping with rage, names himself Rama's brother come for his death and demands single combat -- Lavana, boasting of his kinship to Ravana, bids him wait while he fetches a weapon, but Shatrughna refuses to let the seen foe escape.

shloka_text: ततः प्रभाते विमले तस्मिन्काले स राक्षसः । निर्गतस्तु पुराद्धीरो भक्ष्याहारप्रचोदितः ।। 7.68.2 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ prabhāte vimale tasminkāle sa rākṣasaḥ | nirgatastu purāddhīro bhakṣyāhārapracoditaḥ || 7.68.2 ||
translation: ततः then, प्रभाते in the morning, विमले clear, तस्मिन्काले at that time, सः that, राक्षसः demon, निर्गतस्तु indeed came out, पुरात् from the city, धीरः brave, भक्ष्याहारप्रचोदितः impelled by the desire for food.
explanation: Then, in that clear morning, the brave demon, impelled by his hunger for food, came out of the city.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वीरः शत्रुघ्नो यमुनां नदीम् । तीर्त्वा मधुपुरद्वारि धनुष्पाणिरतिष्ठत ।। 7.68.3 ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare vīraḥ śatrughno yamunāṃ nadīm | tīrtvā madhupuradvāri dhanuṣpāṇiratiṣṭhata || 7.68.3 ||
translation: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे in the meantime, वीरः the brave, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, यमुनां Yamuna, नदीम् river, तीर्त्वा having crossed, मधुपुरद्वारि at the gate of Madhupura, धनुष्पाणिः with bow in hand, अतिष्ठत stood.
explanation: In the meantime, the brave Shatrughna, having crossed the Yamuna river, stood at the gate of Madhupura with his bow in hand.

shloka_text: ततो ऽर्धदिवसे प्राप्ते क्रूरकर्मा स राक्षसः । आगच्छद्बहुसाहस्रं प्राणिनां भारमुद्वहन् ।। 7.68.4 ।।
transliteration: tato 'rdhadivase prāpte krūrakarmā sa rākṣasaḥ | āgacchadbahusāhasraṃ prāṇināṃ bhāramudvahan || 7.68.4 ||
translation: ततः then, अर्धदिवसे midday, प्राप्ते having arrived, क्रूरकर्मा cruel-deeded, सः that, राक्षसः demon, आगच्छत् came, बहुसाहस्रं many thousands, प्राणिनां of living beings, भारम् burden, उद्वहन् carrying.
explanation: Then, as midday arrived, that cruel demon came, carrying the burden of many thousands of living beings.

shloka_text: ततो ददर्श शत्रुघ्नं स्थितं द्वारि धृतायुधम् । तमुवाच ततो रक्षः किमनेन करिष्यसि ।। 7.68.5 ।।
transliteration: tato dadarśa śatrughnaṃ sthitaṃ dvāri dhṛtāyudham | tamuvāca tato rakṣaḥ kimanena kariṣyasi || 7.68.5 ||
translation: ततः then, ददर्श he saw, शत्रुघ्नं Shatrughna, स्थितं standing, द्वारि at the gate, धृतायुधम् holding a weapon, तम् to him, उवाच said, ततः then, रक्षः the demon, किम् what, अनेन with this, करिष्यसि will you do.
explanation: Then he saw Shatrughna standing at the gate, holding a weapon, and the demon then asked him, "What will you do with this?"

shloka_text: ईदृशानां सहस्राणि सायुधानां नराधम । भक्षितानि मया रोषात्कालमाकाङ्क्षसे नु किम् ।। 7.68.6 ।।
transliteration: īdṛśānāṃ sahasrāṇi sāyudhānāṃ narādhama | bhakṣitāni mayā roṣātkālamākāṅkṣase nu kim || 7.68.6 ||
translation: ईदृशानां of such (like you), सहस्राणि thousands, सायुधानां armed, नराधम O vilest of men, भक्षितानि have been devoured, मया by me, रोषात् out of anger, कालम् death, आकाङ्क्षसे do you desire, नु indeed, किम् what.
explanation: "O vilest of men, I have devoured thousands of armed individuals like you out of anger; do you indeed desire death?"

shloka_text: आहारश्चास्य सम्पूर्णो ममायं पुरुषाधम । स्वयं प्रविष्टो ऽद्य मुखं कथमासाद्य दुर्मते ।। 7.68.7 ।।
transliteration: āhāraścāsya sampūrṇo mamāyaṃ puruṣādhama | svayaṃ praviṣṭo 'dya mukhaṃ kathamāsādya durmate || 7.68.7 ||
translation: आहारश्च food and, अस्य his, सम्पूर्णो complete, ममायं my this, पुरुषाधम O vilest of men, स्वयम् by himself, प्रविष्टो entered, अद्य today, मुखं mouth, कथमासाद्य how having reached, दुर्मते O evil-minded one
explanation: The demon, addressing Shatrughna, exclaims that Shatrughna, the vilest and evil-minded of men, has today entered his mouth by himself, thus becoming his complete meal.

shloka_text: तस्यैवं भाषमाणस्य हसतश्च मुहुर्मुहुः । शत्रुघ्नो वीर्यसम्पन्नो रोषादश्रूण्यवासृजत् ।। 7.68.8 ।।
transliteration: tasyaivaṃ bhāṣamāṇasya hasataśca muhurmuhuḥ | śatrughno vīryasampanno roṣādaśrūṇyavāsṛjat || 7.68.8 ||
translation: तस्य his, एवम् thus, भाषमाणस्य while speaking, हसतश्च while laughing and, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, शत्रुघ्नो Shatrughna, वीर्यसम्पन्नो endowed with valor, रोषात् from anger, अश्रूण्यवासृजत् shed tears
explanation: As the demon spoke thus and laughed repeatedly, the valiant Shatrughna shed tears out of intense anger.

shloka_text: तस्य रोषाभिभूतस्य शत्रुघ्नस्य महात्मनः । तेजोमया मरीच्यस्तु सर्वगात्रैर्विनिष्पतन् ।। 7.68.9 ।।
transliteration: tasya roṣābhibhūtasya śatrughnasya mahātmanaḥ | tejomayā marīcyastu sarvagātrairviniṣpatan || 7.68.9 ||
translation: तस्य his, रोषाभिभूतस्य overcome by anger, शत्रुघ्नस्य Shatrughna's, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, तेजोमया radiant, मरीच्यस्तु rays indeed, सर्वगात्रैः from all limbs, विनिष्पतन् burst forth
explanation: From the great-souled Shatrughna, who was overcome by such rage, radiant rays of light emanated from all his limbs.

shloka_text: उवाच च सुसङ्क्रुद्धः शत्रुघ्नस्तं निशाचरम् । योद्धुमिच्छामि दुर्बुद्धे द्वन्द्वयुद्धं त्वया सह ।। 7.68.10 ।।
transliteration: uvāca ca susaṅkruddhaḥ śatrughnastaṃ niśācaram | yoddhumicchāmi durbuddhe dvandvayuddhaṃ tvayā saha || 7.68.10 ||
translation: उवाच spoke, च and, सुसङ्क्रुद्धः very much enraged, शत्रुघ्नस्तं Shatrughna to him, निशाचरम् to the night-wanderer, योद्धुमिच्छामि I wish to fight, दुर्बुद्धे O evil-minded one, द्वन्द्वयुद्धं single combat, त्वया with you, सह together
explanation: And Shatrughna, greatly enraged, spoke to that demon, declaring his wish to engage in single combat with the evil-minded one.

shloka_text: पुत्रो दशरथस्याहं भ्राता रामस्य धीमतः । शत्रुघ्नो नित्यशत्रुघ्नो वधाकाङ्क्षी तवागतः ।। 7.68.11 ।।
transliteration: putro daśarathasyāhaṃ bhrātā rāmasya dhīmataḥ | śatrughno nityaśatrughno vadhākāṅkṣī tavāgataḥ || 7.68.11 ||
translation: पुत्रो son, दशरथस्याहं of Dasharatha I, भ्राता brother, रामस्य of Rama, धीमतः the wise, शत्रुघ्नो Shatrughna, नित्यशत्रुघ्नो the eternal slayer of enemies, वधाकाङ्क्षी desirous of killing, तवागतः your has come
explanation: I am Shatrughna, the son of Dasharatha and brother of the wise Rama, the eternal slayer of enemies, and I have come here desiring your death.

shloka_text: तस्य मे युद्धकामस्य द्वन्द्वयुद्धं प्रदीयताम् । शत्रुस्त्वं सर्वभूतानां न मे जीवन्गमिष्यसि ।। 7.68.12 ।।
transliteration: tasya me yuddhakāmasya dvandvayuddhaṃ pradīyatām | śatrustvaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ na me jīvangamiṣyasi || 7.68.12 ||
translation: तस्य मे for me, युद्धकामस्य desirous of battle, द्वन्द्वयुद्धं a single combat, प्रदीयताम् let it be given. शत्रुस्त्वं you are an enemy, सर्वभूतानां of all beings, न not, मे from me, जीवन् alive, गमिष्यसि you will go.
explanation: Grant me, who desires battle, a single combat, for you are an enemy to all beings, and you shall not escape me alive.

shloka_text: तस्मिंस्तथा ब्रुवाणे तु राक्षसः प्रहसन्निव । प्रत्युवाच नरश्रेष्ठं दिष्ट्या प्राप्तो ऽसि दुर्मते ।। 7.68.13 ।।
transliteration: tasmiṃstathā bruvāṇe tu rākṣasaḥ prahasanniva | pratyuvāca naraśreṣṭhaṃ diṣṭyā prāpto 'si durmate || 7.68.13 ||
translation: तस्मिंस्तथा when he thus, ब्रुवाणे was speaking, तु indeed, राक्षसः the demon, प्रहसन्निव as if laughing, प्रत्युवाच replied, नरश्रेष्ठं to the best of men, दिष्ट्या fortunately, प्राप्तो ऽसि you have arrived, दुर्मते O evil-minded one.
explanation: As he spoke thus, the demon, as if laughing, replied to the best of men, "Fortunately, O evil-minded one, you have arrived!"

shloka_text: मम मातृष्वसुर्भ्राता रावणो राक्षसाधिपः । हतो रामेण दुर्बुद्धे स्त्रीहेतोः पुरुषाधम ।। 7.68.14 ।।
transliteration: mama mātṛṣvasurbhrātā rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ | hato rāmeṇa durbuddhe strīhetoḥ puruṣādhama || 7.68.14 ||
translation: मम my, मातृष्वसुर्भ्राता mother's sister's brother (maternal uncle), रावणो Ravana, राक्षसाधिपः the lord of demons, हतो was killed, रामेण by Rama, दुर्बुद्धे O foolish one, स्त्रीहेतोः for the sake of a woman, पुरुषाधम O lowest of men.
explanation: O foolish one, O lowest of men, my maternal uncle Ravana, the lord of demons, was killed by Rama for the sake of a woman.

shloka_text: तच्च सर्वं मया क्षान्तं रावणस्य कुलक्षयम् । अवज्ञां पुरतः कृत्वा मया यूयं विशेषतः ।। 7.68.15 ।।
transliteration: tacca sarvaṃ mayā kṣāntaṃ rāvaṇasya kulakṣayam | avajñāṃ purataḥ kṛtvā mayā yūyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 7.68.15 ||
translation: तच्च and that, सर्वं all, मया by me, क्षान्तं was tolerated, रावणस्य Ravana's, कुलक्षयम् destruction of the lineage. अवज्ञां disrespect, पुरतः first, कृत्वा having made, मया by me, यूयं you all, विशेषतः especially.
explanation: I tolerated all that, the destruction of Ravana's lineage, but I have especially shown contempt towards you all from the very beginning.

shloka_text: निहताश्च हि मे सर्वे परिभूतास्तृणं यथा । भूताश्चैव भविष्याश्च यूयं च पुरुषाधमाः ।। 7.68.16 ।।
transliteration: nihatāśca hi me sarve paribhūtāstṛṇaṃ yathā | bhūtāścaiva bhaviṣyāśca yūyaṃ ca puruṣādhamāḥ || 7.68.16 ||
translation: निहताश्च and killed, हि indeed, मे by me, सर्वे all, परिभूतास्तृणं insulted like grass, यथा as. भूताश्चैव and those who were (past), भविष्याश्च and those who will be (future), यूयं you all, च and, पुरुषाधमाः O lowest of men.
explanation: Indeed, all of them, past, present, and future, including you, O lowest of men, have been killed and insulted by me as if they were mere grass.

shloka_text: तस्य ते युद्धकामस्य युद्धं दास्यामि दुर्मते । तिष्ठं त्वं च मुहूर्तं तु यावदायुधमानये । ईप्सितं यादृशं तुभ्यं सज्जये यावदायुधम् ।। 7.68.17 ।।
transliteration: tasya te yuddhakāmasya yuddhaṃ dāsyāmi durmate | tiṣṭhaṃ tvaṃ ca muhūrtaṃ tu yāvadāyudhamānaye | īpsitaṃ yādṛśaṃ tubhyaṃ sajjaye yāvadāyudham || 7.68.17 ||
translation: तस्य to that, ते your, युद्धकामस्य one desirous of battle, युद्धं battle, दास्यामि I will give, दुर्मते O evil-minded one, तिष्ठं stand, त्वं you, च and, मुहूर्तं for a moment, तु indeed, यावत् until, आयुधम् weapon, आनये I bring, ईप्सितं desired, यादृशं of what kind, तुभ्यं for you, सज्जये I prepare, यावत् until, आयुधम् weapon
explanation: O evil-minded one, I will give you the battle you desire; just wait for a moment until I bring and prepare the kind of weapon you wish for.

shloka_text: तमुवाचाशु शत्रुघ्नः क्व मे जीवन्गमिष्यसि । शत्रुर्यदृच्छया दृष्टो न मोक्तव्यः कृतात्मना ।। 7.68.18 ।।
transliteration: tamuvācāśu śatrughnaḥ kva me jīvangamiṣyasi | śatruryadṛcchayā dṛṣṭo na moktavyaḥ kṛtātmanā || 7.68.18 ||
translation: तम् to him, उवाच said, आशु quickly, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, क्व where, मे from me, जीवन् alive, गमिष्यसि will you go, शत्रुः an enemy, यदृच्छया by chance, दृष्टः seen, न not, मोक्तव्यः to be released, कृतात्मना by a resolute person
explanation: Shatrughna quickly said to him, "Where will you go alive from me? An enemy, once seen by chance, should not be released by a resolute person."

shloka_text: यो हि विक्लवया बुद्ध्या प्रसरं शत्रवे ददौ । स हतो मन्दबुद्धित्वाद्यथा कापुरुषस्तथा ।। 7.68.19 ।।
transliteration: yo hi viklavayā buddhyā prasaraṃ śatrave dadau | sa hato mandabuddhitvādyathā kāpuruṣastathā || 7.68.19 ||
translation: यः who, हि indeed, विक्लवया confused, बुद्ध्या with intellect, प्रसरं opportunity, शत्रवे to the enemy, ददौ gave, सः he, हतः is killed, मन्दबुद्धित्वात् due to dull-wittedness, यथा just as, कापुरुषः a coward, तथा so
explanation: Indeed, whoever gives an advantage to an enemy with a wavering mind is killed due to his dull-wittedness, just like a coward.

shloka_text: तस्मात्सुदृष्टं कुरु जीवलोकं शरैः शितैस्त्वां विविधैर्नयामि । यमस्य गेहाभिमुखं हि पापं रिपुं त्रिलोकस्य च राघवस्य ।। 7.68.20 ।।
transliteration: tasmātsudṛṣṭaṃ kuru jīvalokaṃ śaraiḥ śitaistvāṃ vividhairnayāmi | yamasya gehābhimukhaṃ hi pāpaṃ ripuṃ trilokasya ca rāghavasya || 7.68.20 ||
translation: तस्मात् therefore, सुदृष्टं well-seen, कुरु make, जीवलोकं the world of living beings, शरैः with arrows, शितैः sharp, त्वां you, विविधैः various, नयामि I will lead, यमस्य of Yama, गेहाभिमुखं towards the house, हि indeed, पापं sinful, रिपुं enemy, त्रिलोकस्य of the three worlds, च and, राघवस्य of Rama
explanation: Therefore, take a good look at the world of the living, for I shall lead you, a sinful enemy of the three worlds and of Rama, towards Yama's abode with various sharp arrows. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टषष्टितमः सर्गः ।। 68 ।। Thus ends the sixty-eighth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
